data: A 51-km D-type Trojan in Jupiter's leading L4 swarm. D-type asteroids are believed to be among the most primitive bodies in the solar system, with surface composition that preserves chemistry from the outer protoplanetary disc largely unchanged for 4.5 billion years.

Orus is a C-type L4 Trojan — Lucy flyby November 2028. Its dark, carbon-rich spectrum is closer to Kuiper-belt objects than to inner-belt asteroids.
